short_bio: Film director and producer of Jaws, E.T., Schindler’s List and Saving Private Ryan.
biography:
Steven Spielberg was born in Cincinnati, Ohio, and made amateur films as a boy. After the television film Duel (1971) and The Sugarland Express (1974), Jaws (1975) established the summer blockbuster.

Close Encounters of the Third Kind came in 1977, then Raiders of the Lost Ark in 1981 and E.T. in 1982. Schindler’s List (1993) won Best Picture and Best Director, and he won Best Director again for Saving Private Ryan (1998).

In 1994 he co-founded DreamWorks with Jeffrey Katzenberg and David Geffen and also set up the Shoah Foundation, which records testimony from Holocaust survivors. The Fabelmans (2022) draws on his own childhood.
